A bustling month on feeding routines, minutes
The lead dispatcher welcomed everyone

The lead dispatcher welcomed everyone and opened the staff meeting with a calm review of current companion travel handling. Attendees were Rina Kim, Hugo Suleiman, Hazel, Mara, Elias, and Nia. The team noted that requests remain steady, and that clear handoffs between booking, crate prep, and boarding support continue to help travelers feel reassured.

Operations updates focused on smoother intake and cleaner notes in each file. <<FACT F104>> The group agreed that when a case needs extra review, the escalation path should stay simple and consistent so no pet or traveler is left waiting without guidance.

Booking support was also discussed. <<FACT F091>> Staff agreed to keep confirmations warm and precise, with special attention to feeding instructions, medication reminders, and any comfort items linked to the journey. The meeting ended with agreement that the next shift will keep the same careful pace and report any concerns early.
